title: High-Fidelity Telemetry Modal & Realistic Personas with Global Graphify Integration
description: Implement a high-fidelity neobrutalist three-tab modal in Assembly Matrix showing comprehensive spawning telemetry (Agent ID, Parent ID, LLM Model, Cohort Scale, Active Thread), MBTI cognitive style analysis, OCEAN personality scales, custom emotional triggers, and an interactive horizontal Buyer Journey stepper. To eliminate cognitive bias, harden LLM prompts and fallback registries to generate realistic human names (e.g. 'Marcus Vance', 'Sophia Patel') instead of role titles. Finally, integrate the 'graphifyy' package globally to analyze workspace structures and render visual trees using the slash command.
expected_impact: Drastically improves user comprehension of active simulation states and decreases boardroom bias, while providing developers with powerful global codebase structural learning.
technical_complexity: Medium (Frontend Overhaul, Prompt Hardening, Global Command Registration)
dependencies: Overhaul details modal with tabs and SVG progress bars in AssemblyMatrix.tsx
Integrate graphifyy global path in Antigravity assistant skills
success_metrics: Zero compilation warnings on clean tsc build
100% realistic names generated in simulation runs
Clean render of spawning telemetry and buyer journey steps
